description: kani-harnesses/vb_compile_slot.rs imports `use vb_compile::lower_slot_reference_for_testing` but this function does not exist in vb_compile crate. lower_slot_reference is a private fn in expression_bytecode.rs.
fix: Export lower_slot_reference_for_testing as pub(crate) from expression_bytecode.rs, or rewrite harness to use public API (compile_expr_to_bytecode_with_accessors on ParsedExpression::Reference)

description: kani-harnesses/*.rs files are standalone files at workspace root, not integrated into vb_compile crate via #[cfg(kani)] modules. cargo kani will fail with 'could not find harness'.
fix: Create crates/vb_compile/src/kani/ directory, move harness files there, add #[cfg(kani)] pub mod kani; to lib.rs following kani_idempotency_parity pattern

description: scripts/rust-verification-gauntlet.sh referenced by moon tasks verify-fast, verify-standard, verify-deep, verify-proof does not exist in workspace
fix: Create scripts/rust-verification-gauntlet.sh or update moon tasks to use existing verification command

description: kani-harnesses/vb_compile_slot.rs function lower_slot_reference_with_path_creates_accessor (lines 116-147) is missing #[kani::proof] attribute. Kani will not recognize it as a proof harness.
lower_slot_reference_valid contains while i < edge_cases.len() with #[kani::unwind(6)]. edge_cases.len() == 6 is at the unwind boundary. Kani may not fully explore all iterations.
fix: Use #[kani::unwind(8)] or restructure to avoid loop over fixed array (test each case individually)

description: Test 5 (lines 118-131) uses kani::assume(count <= MAX_EXPRESSION_OPS) then checks if count > MAX_EXPRESSION_OPS. The assume eliminates all states where count > MAX_EXPRESSION_OPS, making the assertion unreachable and providing zero coverage of the overflow path.
fix: Remove kani::assume before the dimension being tested. Test the count > MAX_EXPRESSION_OPS path directly without assume.

description: Test 7 (lines 155-183) parses hardcoded expressions and verifies they compile but does not verify Err paths for compile_expr_to_bytecode. Missing coverage for helper arity errors and deeply nested expressions that would cause stack overflow.
fix: Add explicit Err test cases: (1) helper with wrong arity, (2) deeply nested expression exceeding MAX_EXPRESSION_STACK, (3) expression with too many ops

description: push_constant_overflow pre-fills compiler using while i < 65535 loop with #[kani::unwind(10)]. 65535 >> 10, so Kani will not exhaustively explore all iterations. The overflow test is not exhaustive.
fix: Use symbolic approach instead: (a) Pre-fill with a concrete repeat_n(ConstValue::I64(0), 65535), then verify NEXT call fails, OR (b) use kani::any::<u16>() for index and verify Err when pool is at capacity

description: Test 7 in vb_compile_bytecode.rs uses a while loop to iterate over test_exprs, but the test only checks the happy path (programs compile with correct max_stack). No adversarial cases for Err paths.
fix: Add adversarial cases to test_exprs array: empty expression, deeply nested expression, too many ops
